periods.analysis: All of our measures demonstrate that we are increasing our value to shareholders. We have been maintaining a double digit net profit for the past 7 months by keeping our expenses down and continuing to consistently grow our revenue. We are happy with our performance.
periods.recommendations: Over the past half year we have demonstrated that our company is on the right path. We are confident that we will continue to build value for our shareholders and that our strategy of tightly managing our expenses and improving airplane turnaround time has started to bear fruit.

periods.analysis: In December 2025, Upward Airlines faced a revenue shortfall, achieving only 90.48% of its target, attributed to potential seasonal fluctuations or operational issues. However, expenses were well-managed, staying below target, which positively impacted the bottom line. Initiatives to create new revenue streams, like expanding ancillary services and loyalty programs, showed promising progress. Despite some divisions facing challenges, overall profitability was trending positively, with strategic cost management and successful sales initiatives contributing to shareholder value.
periods.recommendations:
Continue to focus on cost reduction strategies, exploring new ways to minimize expenses without compromising service quality. 
 Pursue avenues for revenue growth, such as expanding routes or improving in-flight services. 
 Maintain operational efficiency, ensuring all processes are streamlined and effective.
